original_title: From 19 Inches of Venom to... Nothing — There's No Marvel's Wolverine Collector's Edition and Insomniac Fans Don't Know Why
summary_en: Following the explosive gameplay reveal of Marvel's Wolverine, Insomniac Games confirmed a surprising absence: no collector's edition. This decision has left fans disappointed and questioning the studio's usual approach.
ai_analysis: The absence of a collector's edition for Marvel's Wolverine, especially after Insomniac's history with such offerings and the immense popularity of the character, raises questions about current market trends and fan expectations for physical game releases.

en.title: No Collector's Edition for Marvel's Wolverine? Fans Are Left Asking Why
en.summary: Following the explosive gameplay reveal of Marvel's Wolverine, Insomniac Games confirmed a surprising absence: no collector's edition. This decision has left fans disappointed and questioning the studio's usual approach.
en.body:
The recent PlayStation State of Play offered a tantalizing glimpse into Insomniac Games' highly anticipated **Marvel's Wolverine**. We saw brutal combat, a mature tone, and the promise of another stellar single-player experience from the studio behind **Marvel's Spider-Man** and **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**. However, in the wake of the showcase, Insomniac Games delivered a piece of news that has left many fans scratching their heads: there will be no collector's edition for **Marvel's Wolverine**.

Instead of the usual array of statues, steelbooks, and art books that often accompany major first-party PlayStation releases, players will only have the standard edition and a digital deluxe edition to choose from. This is a notable departure from Insomniac's own track record; both **Marvel's Spider-Man** and **Marvel's Spider-Man 2** received robust collector's editions, with the latter famously featuring a 19-inch Venom statue. While **Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales** skipped a collector's edition, the circumstances surrounding its release during the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic were unique and largely accepted as a logistical necessity. The lack of a physical collector's edition for **Marvel's Wolverine**, however, comes without immediate explanation and feels like a missed opportunity to cater to the dedicated fanbase.

## Fan Disappointment and Speculation
The online community has reacted with a mixture of confusion and disappointment. On platforms like Reddit, discussions have quickly surfaced, with many users expressing their frustration. The absence of a physical edition is seen by some as a worrying sign for the future of physical media in gaming, especially when compared to the elaborate collector's editions offered for other recent titles like **Death Stranding 2** and **Ghost of Yotei**. The desire for tangible collectibles, like a potential Wolverine statue that could rival the infamous Venom figure, is palpable. Some fans are even linking this decision to other perceived shortcomings, such as the lack of a special edition DualSense controller.

## What's Next for Insomniac's Claws?
With the release of **Marvel's Wolverine** still slated for later in 2026, the focus will undoubtedly shift back to the gameplay and narrative Insomniac is crafting. Details about the digital deluxe edition's in-game items have not yet been fully revealed, and it remains to be seen if any other special merchandise will be offered outside of the standard game packages. For now, fans will have to content themselves with the digital offerings and hope that the game itself lives up to the immense anticipation, even without a premium physical release.

tr.title: Marvel's Wolverine için Koleksiyoncu Sürümü Yok Mu? Hayranlar Nedenini Sorguluyor
tr.summary: Marvel's Wolverine'in oynanış videosu ortaya çıktıktan sonra Insomniac Games, beklenmedik bir haber verdi: oyun için koleksiyoncu sürümü olmayacak. Bu karar hayranları hayal kırıklığına uğrattı ve stüdyonun geleneksel yaklaşımını sorgulamalarına neden oldu.
tr.body:
## Marvel's Wolverine Koleksiyoncu Sürümünün Eksikliği
Son PlayStation State of Play'de Insomniac Games'in çok beklenen **Marvel's Wolverine** oyununa bir göz attık. Şiddeti yüksek bir combat, olgun bir ton ve **Marvel's Spider-Man** ve **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**'nin arkasındaki stüdyonun bir başka mükemmel single-player deneyimi vaat edildi. Ancak, gösterinin ardından Insomniac Games, birçok hayranı şaşırtan bir haber verdi: **Marvel's Wolverine** için koleksiyoncu sürümü olmayacak.

Bunun yerine, büyük first-party PlayStation sürümlerine thường eşlik eden heykeller, steelbook'lar ve sanat kitapları yerine, oyuncular sadece standard sürüm ve dijital deluxe sürüm arasında seçim yapabilecekler. Bu, Insomniac'in kendi geçmişine göre önemli bir ayrılık. Hem **Marvel's Spider-Man** hem de **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**, robust koleksiyoncu sürümlerine sahipti; ikincisi, ünlü 19 inçlik Venom heykelini içeriyordu. **Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales**, koleksiyoncu sürümünü atladı, ancak COVID-19 salgınının ilk günlerinde ortaya çıkan circumstances, büyük ölçüde lojistik bir zorunluluk olarak kabul edildi. **Marvel's Wolverine** için fiziksel koleksiyoncu sürümünün eksikliği ise, açıklama yapılmadan geldi ve sadık hayranlara hitap etme fırsatının kaçırıldığı hissediliyor.

## Hayranların Hayal Kırıklığı ve Spekülasyon
Çevrimiçi topluluk, karışıklık ve hayal kırıklığı ile tepki verdi. Reddit gibi platformlarda, birçok kullanıcı frustrasyonlarını dile getirdi. Fiziksel sürümün eksikliği, bazıları tarafından fiziksel medyanın geleceği için endişe verici bir işaret olarak görülüyor, özellikle de **Death Stranding 2** ve **Ghost of Yotei** gibi diğer recent başlıkların sunmuş olduğu elaboratif koleksiyoncu sürümlerine kıyasla. Somut koleksiyonların, potansiyel bir Wolverine heykelinin, ünlü Venom figürünü rakip olabilecek bir şeyin arzusu hissediliyor. Bazı hayranlar, bu kararı diğer algılanan eksikliklerle, örneğin özel bir DualSense kontrolcüsünün olmamasıyla, bağlantılı görüyor.

## Insomniac'in Pençelerinin Geleceği
**Marvel's Wolverine**'in 2026'nın ilerleyen günlerinde çıkması planlanırken, odak noktası without şüphesiz oyunun oynanışına ve Insomniac'in inşa ettiği narrative'e kayacak. Dijital deluxe sürümünün in-game item'lerinin ayrıntıları henüz tam olarak açıklanmadı ve standard oyun paketlerinin dışında diğer özel ürünlerin sunulup sunulmayacağı görülmesi gereken bir şey. Şimdilik, hayranlar dijital tekliflerle yetinmek ve oyunun kendisinin immense beklentileri karşılayacağı umuduyla yaşamak zorunda kalacak.

es.title: ¿No hay edición coleccionista para Marvel's Wolverine? Los fanáticos se preguntan por qué
es.summary: Después de la explosiva revelación del gameplay de Marvel's Wolverine, Insomniac Games confirmó una sorprendente ausencia: no habrá edición coleccionista. Esta decisión ha dejado a los fanáticos decepcionados y cuestionando el enfoque habitual del estudio. La comunidad en línea ha reaccionado con confusión y decepción, y muchos se preguntan si esto es un signo de los tiempos para el futuro de los medios físicos en los videojuegos.
es.body:
La reciente presentación de PlayStation State of Play ofreció un vistazo tentador al muy anticipado **Marvel's Wolverine** de Insomniac Games. Vimos un combate brutal, un tono maduro y la promesa de otra experiencia de un solo jugador estelar del estudio detrás de **Marvel's Spider-Man** y **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**. Sin embargo, después de la presentación, Insomniac Games dio una noticia que ha dejado a muchos fanáticos rascándose la cabeza: no habrá edición coleccionista para **Marvel's Wolverine**.

En lugar de la habitual variedad de estatuas, steelbooks y libros de arte que suelen acompañar a los lanzamientos principales de PlayStation, los jugadores solo tendrán la edición estándar y una edición digital deluxe para elegir. Esto es un notable alejamiento del historial de Insomniac; tanto **Marvel's Spider-Man** como **Marvel's Spider-Man 2** recibieron robustas ediciones coleccionistas, con la segunda que famosamente presentaba una estatua de Venom de 19 pulgadas. Mientras que **Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales** omitió una edición coleccionista, las circunstancias que rodearon su lanzamiento durante los primeros días de la pandemia de COVID-19 fueron únicas y en gran medida aceptadas como una necesidad logística. La falta de una edición coleccionista física para **Marvel's Wolverine**, sin embargo, llega sin explicación inmediata y se siente como una oportunidad perdida para atender a la base de fanáticos dedicados.

## Desilusión y especulación de los fanáticos
La comunidad en línea ha reaccionado con una mezcla de confusión y decepción. En plataformas como Reddit, han surgido discusiones rápidamente, con muchos usuarios expresando su frustración. La ausencia de una edición física se ve como un signo inquietante para el futuro de los medios físicos en los videojuegos, especialmente cuando se compara con las elaboradas ediciones coleccionistas ofrecidas para otros títulos recientes como **Death Stranding 2** y **Ghost of Yotei**. El deseo de coleccionables tangibles, como una posible estatua de Wolverine que podría rivalizar con la infame figura de Venom, es palpable. Algunos fanáticos incluso están vinculando esta decisión con otras deficiencias percibidas, como la falta de un controlador DualSense especial.

## ¿Qué sigue para las garras de Insomniac?
Con el lanzamiento de **Marvel's Wolverine** aún programado para más tarde en 2026, el enfoque sin duda se desplazará de regreso al gameplay y la narrativa que Insomniac está creando. Los detalles sobre los artículos en el juego de la edición digital deluxe aún no han sido revelados por completo, y queda por ver si se ofrecerá algún otro merchandising especial fuera de los paquetes de juego estándar. Por ahora, los fanáticos tendrán que contentarse con las ofertas digitales y esperar que el juego en sí mismo cumpla con la inmensa anticipación, incluso sin un lanzamiento físico de alta gama.

content_raw: If you were expecting a flashy collector's edition for Marvel's Wolverine , don't hold your breath. Following Wolverine's explosive gameplay reveal at the PlayStation State of Play showcase, Insomniac Games confirmed that the game will not be getting any kind of collector's edition. Instead, players will be able to choose from the standard edition and a digital deluxe edition, which includes in-game items. That means there won't be a version of the game with cool physical goodies like a steelbook, statue, or art book. Insomniac Games didn't clarify why there won't be one, as it's pretty standard for major PlayStation first-party games to have a big collector's editions. Death Stranding 2 and Ghost of Yotei both had expensive special editions last year with physical items, and Insomniac has a notable history with these as well. Marvel's Spider-Man 1 and 2 both had collector's editions with statues, with the latter game being rather infamous for its 19-inch Venom statue . Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales didn't have one, but that may have also been a result of COVID hindering the ability to mass-produce items and ship them out. Fans are naturally pretty disappointed, as it would be cool to have a mini-Wolverine striking a cool pose. Some said it could be a bad sign for the future of physical media. "Probably not a great sign for physical media honestly. At least they're releasing a standard edition, I guess," said one Reddit user . "Disappointing," remarked another . "The Spider-Man 2 Venom statue was so sick. A Wolverine in that vein would have been neat. Also no special DualSense announcement yet either? Dropping the ball here for sure." "The decision makes no sense," said another user . "There aren't many other first-party games that would sell out a collector's edition like this one." In recent years, PlayStation collector's editions haven't featured a physical copy of the game. They come with digital codes, likely because not every PS5 has a disc drive and Sony doesn't want to exclude those players. One player speculated that physical media enthusisasts simply aren't investing in these editions due to the lack of a disc. "[Spider-Man 2's collector's edition] didn’t sell well because there was no physical disc in it thus defeating the entire point of getting it," said one person . "Look at the new Assassin’s Creed [Black Flag Resynced] collector's edition. It literally sold out within minutes. That’s how you do a collector’s edition." Of course, there's still time for Sony to reveal a limited edition PS5 console to tie into Marvel's Wolverine, but the high-cost of consoles these days may have presented challenges. Still, it's unlikely any of this will actually hurt the game as fans seem pretty enthusiastic following Marvel's Wolverine's recent State of Play outing.
